philly_sales.source: City of Philadelphia, Office of Property Assessment - opa_properties_public via the Carto SQL API
philly_sales.query: see data/fetch_philly.py SELECT - sale_price > 50000, SINGLE FAMILY + MULTI FAMILY, sale_date >= 2025-09-01, ORDER BY md5(parcel||sale_date)
philly_sales.note: pages are a deterministic pseudo-random shuffle of the window, so 4 pages is a fair sample. run `python bright.py fetch` to pull the full window (23 pages) or `--since 2024-01-01` for ~40k rows.
philly_sales.license: City of Philadelphia open data, public domain / CC0-style terms per opendataphilly.org

redfin_market_tracker.source: Redfin Data Center - county_market_tracker.tsv000.gz (monthly, all counties)
redfin_market_tracker.filter: 13 bright-footprint counties, property_type in (All Residential, Single Family Residential), monthly rows, period_begin >= 2023-01-01
redfin_market_tracker.attribution: data from Redfin (redfin.com/news/data-center); redfin asks for attribution when its data is used
